name: premiereremote
description: PremiereRemote - MCP, HTTP, and WS servers for Adobe Premiere Pro UXP
author: sebinside

scripts.build: pnpm run setup && pnpm run bundle
scripts.dev: pnpm run clean && node scripts/copy-static.js && nodemon --watch src --ignore src/generated --ext ts --exec "node scripts/generate-api.js && pnpm run bundle && node scripts/sync-build.js"
scripts.setup: pnpm run clean && node scripts/generate-api.js && node scripts/copy-static.js
scripts.prepare-packaging: node scripts/clean.js node_modules && pnpm install --prod && node scripts/prepare-packaging.js
